_doc: Landmarks (praxis/landmarks.py). Task landmarks come from each graph's node `parts`; `anchors` adds a few per task (none needed for the current library). `non_task` are things that never belong to a task: with high P(away) they mean an interruption, not that the task ended. Non-task landmarks are unmeasured on CaptainCook4D (none appear there).
